description.zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支。
description.en: The branch ID, which uniquely identifies a Supabase branch.

description.zh: 地域 ID。创建主分支时必须指定，创建子分支时默认继承主分支所在地域。
description.en: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a child branch, the region of the primary branch is inherited by default.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于查询指定 Supabase 分支的详细信息，返回分支基础属性、父分支信息、保护状态和连接信息。
descriptions.en: Queries the detailed information of a specified Supabase branch, including basic branch attributes, parent branch information, protection status, and connection information.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-branch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --branch-id br-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
